title: Customer Definition Funnel
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Entrepreneurship
description: A five-band funnel that narrows Priya's meal-prep market from a broad market (families who eat dinner) through a market segment, a niche market, and a target customer to an ideal customer profile and persona (Dana, an ER nurse on rotating shifts). Learners step through the bands or click one to see its definition, the filter that narrowed it, Priya's example, and the example one band wider.

prerequisites: Chapter 4 reading through From Broad Market to Target Customer
educational.topic: Narrowing a broad market to a target customer, ideal customer profile, and persona
learningObjectives: Explain how a broad market narrows step by step into a market segment, a niche market, a target customer, and an ideal customer profile / persona
Locate Priya's concrete example at each stage of the funnel
Name the filter that separates each stage from the stage above it

controls.label: Funnel bands
controls.purpose: Select one of the five stages to show its definition, the filter that narrowed it, and Priya's example

controls.label: Widen Back
controls.purpose: Select the band one level wider (also the up or left arrow key)

controls.label: Narrow Next
controls.purpose: Select the band one level narrower (also the down or right arrow key)

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Step-through of a static diagram with a concrete worked example at every stage
keyQuestions: What filter was added to get from the band above to this one?
Is this description a group of people or one specific person?
Could Priya find and reach the people described at this stage?
commonMisconceptions: A broad market such as families who eat dinner is specific enough to be a target customer
Narrowing the customer shrinks the business rather than sharpening it
A persona is invented from imagination rather than grounded in research on real customers
assessmentOpportunities: Name the stage of each of Priya's five examples when they are read out of order
Explain the difference between a target customer and a persona using Dana
